_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION THRESHOLDS -- NOT CLINICAL GUIDELINES. These values were written by the project team to be internally plausible for a prototype. They are not drawn from any validated source, have not been reviewed by a clinician, and must never be used for real triage.
_phase_note: Phase 3 defines the ADULT band only. Phases 4 adds infant, child, adolescent and geriatric. Until then the engine falls back to adult values for every age, which is deliberately unsafe and is demonstrated as such by scripts/run_triage.py.
_reading_the_bands: For each vital: critical_low < low < high < critical_high. A value outside low..high is a MILD deviation. A value outside critical_low..critical_high is a SEVERE deviation. spo2 has no upper bound.
